glosses: gang; street gang (criminal group, especially one that practices petty crime)
gang (a group of friends who do things together regularly, especially mischievous children)

examples.en: You must steer clear of that gang.

examples.text: Tom foi morto pelos membros de sua própria gangue.
examples.en: Tom was killed by his own gang members.

examples.text: Alguém entregou os membros da gangue para a polícia.
examples.en: Somebody tipped off the gang members to the police surveillance.

examples.text: O Tom é um membro de uma gangue.
examples.en: Tom is a member of a gang.
